text: Course positioning and objectivesOncology is an interdisciplinary field that studies the occurrence, development, diagnosis, treatment and prevention of tumors, integrating basic medicine, clinical medicine and translational medicine. Through this course, students will:Master the biological characteristics, clinical staging and multidisciplinary diagnosis and treatment strategies of malignant tumors;Be familiar with the application of cutting-edge technologies such as precision oncology and immunotherapy;Cultivate clinical thinking in tumor prevention and treatment, and understand the core value of "individualized treatment" in tumor management
